verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a game engine that exposes MCP and CLI surfaces, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only markdown docs, an llms.txt index, and MCP docs-search/read tools. Those are adjacent documentation access, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
